candidates.finding: Check whether concurrent skipped/failed predecessors can cause a duplicate or stranded DAG join worker.
candidates.screening_result: Source default main@ee1e74cb6e2c94775db88dddb311f2235e3fe9e3, GitHub LICENSE API Apache-2.0. At current source the graph joins wait for all incoming edges, started.insert(target) atomically rejects duplicate launches and empty aggregated inputs propagate terminal skip. No native reproducer of a duplicate or stranded supported join established.

candidates.finding: Check whether a stale card holder can release a newer card owner after a concurrent reclaim.
candidates.screening_result: Source default main@35cffa653b83101d67c6706f3561b00251614621, GitHub LICENSE API MIT. The current claim and DELETE release handlers run under withWriteLock, with release checking claimedBy against body.by but no required claim generation. A stale same-holder release after a re-claim is a plausible ABA question, not a proven supported failure. No independent native RED or maintainer issue-policy basis established.
candidates.blocker: Unproven same-actor ABA release impact/contract; requires first-party native regression and contributor intent before API change.

candidates.finding: Check whether competing Retry-After responses can shorten an already extended provider cooldown.
candidates.screening_result: Source default main@46378bd1663ef998ac695b2e4f76e337fb35d97f, GitHub LICENSE API Apache-2.0. First-party RetryCooldown.note_retry_after locks a shared not_before and sets it only when the new deadline is later. The proposed shorter-overwrite race is contradicted by inspected source; no eligible change.

candidates.finding: Check whether a background read-only delegate can mutate via a first-party indirect tool path.
candidates.screening_result: Source default main@3be6ff94b5e7adfee30f5ead8972dbdbbb5c4319, GitHub LICENSE API MIT. Delegate scheduling explicitly serializes ordinary mutating work and only treats read-only or isolated/background flows as concurrent. No concrete first-party indirect write bypass or deterministic supported failing scenario established.
candidates.blocker: No deterministic source-native writable background delegate bypass or policy-consistent fix demonstrated.

candidates.finding: Check whether concurrent MCP claims can return success to two owners for one pending task.
candidates.screening_result: Source default main@cf46b89d75dfbffb5b34b47d709fb28d149942a9, GitHub LICENSE API Apache-2.0. Current TaskRepository.claim performs UPDATE ... WHERE id=? AND status=pending, and DB.claimTask executes claim inside a transaction then checks status and assigned_to. The hypothesized two successful owners is not supported by inspected transaction path.

candidates.finding: Check whether equivalent rooted path spellings or file swaps evade the first-party mutation gate.
candidates.screening_result: Source default main@1047f8e933442fa156d53ca78aa869792e9f9188, GitHub LICENSE API MIT. The global rootedMutationGate serializes built-in tool mutations regardless of path spelling, and rootedEditSnapshot.validate checks file identity, content and target name before replacement. It explicitly excludes an external writer racing final rename; the proposed in-process alias bypass is unsupported.

candidates.finding: Check whether child VFS payload merge can silently replace an independently changed parent buffer.
candidates.screening_result: Source default main@1b8e48d80779a7f54fde71908943d4b773e4bf05, GitHub LICENSE API GPL-3.0. The current child-context merge writes pending child VFS content into the parent; parent-divergence semantics require a first-party deterministic Emacs regression and review of GPL-3.0 target contribution constraints. No separate-runner RED/GREEN receipt or product-native requirement established.
candidates.blocker: Missing first-party reproducible parent/child merge scenario, GPL-3.0 contributor review and independent native runner.

candidates.finding: Check whether concurrent Linear issue claim conventions allow duplicate feature work without a CAS.
candidates.screening_result: Source default main@c37dc096993011cb0cc48a0afab176cd9c8f2375, GitHub LICENSE API MIT. The source uses a Linear issue status and coding-prompt convention, not a first-party atomic server claim interface. No validated supported source-native CAS endpoint or maintainer-requested backwards-compatible alternative; do not equate an unenforced convention with a proven fixable source bug.
candidates.blocker: Prompt-only coordination; no first-party transactional claim mechanism or maintainer-approved native API to amend.
